method.competitor_unit: One fish prefab entry per APK bundle/root pair, including variants. Use enabled MeshRenderer and SkinnedMeshRenderer submeshes. Exclude the three key props, boot and pop can in the qmdy2 Fishes folder.
method.geometry_signature: Ordered float32 vertex positions plus ordered triangle indices and submesh lengths. Does not incorporate materials, UVs or rigging, and does not match reordered or transformed equivalents.
method.comparison_unit: Each installed Foundry GLB or each locally exported database OBJ. The database contains per-mesh exports and variants, including partial geometries.
method.visual_scope: Normalized-length static rest geometry and base color maps under one light. Public videos are separate, with no confirmed version. No on-device play, runtime LOD selection, frame rate, animation quality or custom shader reproduction measured.
